theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_hasDerivAt_det_of_entries
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A : ℝ → Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (A' : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) (t M M' : ℝ), (∀ i j, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ A s i j) (A' i j) t) → (∀ i j, |A t i j| ≤ M) → (∀ i j, |A' i j| ≤ M') → ∃ D : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ (A s).det) D t ∧ |D| ≤ (N.factorial : ℝ) * N * M' * M ^ (N - 1) ∧ (A t = 1 → D = A'.trace)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
